baseline: v139 exact options, no starting prior; s2v55/56/57 candidates OFF

trigger.source: pre-resampling measured posterior; ESS convention N/2
trigger.covariance_ratio: diagnostic only: no universal published degeneracy threshold

planner.features: nearest visible same-color floor-boundary crossing or mapped door; no unique IDs supplied as sensor signatures
planner.noise: existing landmark sigma_range=.2m, sigma_bearing=3deg, random_fraction=.05; existing KLD entropy bins .5m/.5m/10deg
planner.geometry: fixed commanded-arm camera calibration, static map occlusion; hypothetical detection only
planner.safety: whole rotation and return enclosed by existing commanded arm/cargo swept radius + 2sigma; static walls/terrain and own RGB risk only; no GT contacts
planner.budget: reserve outward+return pulse stopping horizons plus observation waits BEFORE action; charged time including resume settling <= elapsed non-active/9; no final denominator borrowing
planner.resumption: return to original commanded heading, preserve arm/grip and mission state; clear route cache and replan

offline_gates.selection: argmax information among safe budget-admitted actions; compare stay view

physical_evaluation.near_truth: within .10m and 5deg; evaluation-only mass from sealed particle snapshots

stopping: No tuning after results. Retain every failure/exclusion. If same actual physical failure repeats twice, stop and mark unexecuted seeds excluded; no replacement.
